description.value: Strait Coffee is a café and in-house roastery that has been serving the Wilson Creek area of Sechelt since 1996, growing from a small space into a larger corner location at Wilson Creek Plaza on the Sunshine Coast Highway. The café offers an extensive made-from-scratch menu spanning specialty espresso drinks, full breakfasts, sandwiches, and wraps alongside retail and wholesale coffee beans roasted on-site. A wholesale operation runs in parallel, making it a notable regional coffee producer as well as a full-service sit-down café.

address.value: Unit 1, 4330 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Sechelt, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active café and roastery at Unit 1, 4330 Sunshine Coast Hwy, Sechelt BC, with phone 604.885.9757 — consistent with OSM address tags. concerns: OSM name 'Strait Coffee Traders' does not match website branding ('Strait Coffee') or legal name ('Strait Coffee Roasters Inc.') — 'Traders' appears to be an OSM data error.
Community field lists 'Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Sechelt/Wilson Creek is on the Sunshine Coast mainland, not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands.
Blog/news posts on website are dated 2017–2018, suggesting the site is not actively maintained, though contact details and menu content appear current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established café and roastery operating since 1996 on the Sunshine Coast Highway with a full food menu — a natural and useful stop for touring cyclists traveling the Sunshine Coast.
